label: Use v4.0.0.0 as the committed fixture base and overlay the current /doctor:update router, doctor route manifest, presentation, release-update.cjs and five action YAMLs; the .0 and .2 tag trees contain only the legacy doctor-update.yaml/presentation, not the modern engine. Scope updater runs to intended skill units so the overlaid commands/doctor unit does not contaminate classification.

Build four statuses from distinct fixtures: customized = local-only webflow SKILL.md edit plus target-release changelog edits; conflict = Barter sk-git snapshot plus a deliberate overlap on a baseline file also changed in target; removed = local test tag based on v4.0.0.2 deleting a complete baseline unit; local = one committed custom sk-code-web-dev SKILL.md absent from base and target. Stock v4.0.0.0 to .2 has no removed skill roots.

Commit the local fixture overrides for repeatability and commit base.json after record-base. Indexed tracked files contribute worktree bytes to check/align; untracked additions are not in the local path set. Apply refuses planned paths dirty against HEAD. record-base requires a local tag and clean base.json; offline --trust-release bypasses nearest-tag verification and marks its result unverified.

The requested hidden worktree directory violates sk-git naming. Use the numbered named-worktree allocator with a local worktrees/NNN-slug branch and --no-provision; long-lived fixtures belong on a branch, while detached worktrees are numbered throwaway experiments.

After an approved apply, immediately rollback using the same runDir, require restored paths with skipped=[], confirm the lock is absent and the checkout matches the fixture commit. Rollback leaves paths changed after apply untouched, so isolate/reset each mutation before the next scenario and retain ignored run evidence with fresh run IDs.

Use the common worktree for all seven listed doctor commands, with per-scenario reset. Update 12 system-spec-kit scenarios, 4 skill-advisor, all 4 deep-loop, 4 stateful sk-git scenarios and 3 mcp scenarios; keep read-only git hooks-list/git target-menu and mcp target-menu scenario files as-is. Add DOC-379 for the updater lifecycle and DOC-380 for unknown MCP flags.
